context:
Goal: main goes green again so the queued pull requests can merge.
Problem (rule): main has been red since #3596 merged, your red-main rule lets only its revert merge, and no session can push that revert, so it needs your hands.
Based on (read): a template names the owner inside the private repo name, so a test fails (the consultant's and coordinator's reading, relayed; its fix already sits on #3602's branch). A revert of #3596 touches code and tests, and a builder cannot edit tests (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests).
Based on (read): triage read the push runs of checks.yml on main by REST at 18:24 CST: #3596's run 43975053159 failure (finished 18:10 CST); #3543's run 43973911859 success on attempt 2 (18:20 CST); runs for #3598 and #3601 still in progress. The consultant's claim that #3543 also breaks main is withdrawn: its rail-jump test (page.test.mjs:6253) failed once and passed on re-run, so it flakes.
Based on (ruling): git-red-main-reverts (only the blamed commit's revert merges on a red main).
Departs from: main — only the revert of the blamed commit may merge while main is red, and no role can push it; a has you press Revert on #3596 and merge it, which takes the #3596 change off main until it lands again.
Meanwhile: #3469 and the queue behind it wait; #3602 stays open with the fix.
Waiting on: you.
